T004.acceptance_criteria: The SU(2) trace projection, WZW vertex dimension, k=1 mapping, resolved-entropy expression, and O(1) typical-sector scaling pass independent algebraic checks.

T005.acceptance_criteria: Discrete Fourier projection, Ising parity/disorder identity, parity-resolved Renyi formula and equipartition limit, and parafermion central charge/dimensions pass formula-level checks.

T006.acceptance_criteria: Charge-resolved replica moments and flux moments are exact discrete-Fourier pairs for n=2 and for a higher-replica n=3 validation.

required_input_schema.finite_ising_hamiltonian: Complete finite-chain Hamiltonian, sign convention, and normalization used for the stated numerical verification.
required_input_schema.boundary_and_sector_convention: Boundary conditions, parity-sector projection, and treatment of fermionic boundary terms.
required_input_schema.subsystem_and_size_grid: Every total length, subsystem length, and aspect ratio used in the finite-size comparison.
required_input_schema.replica_and_fit_protocol: Replica orders, finite-size fit ansatz, excluded sizes, tolerances, and uncertainty treatment.

T007.acceptance_boundary: Construct the finite critical-Ising density matrix independently for every disclosed size and parity sector, evaluate resolved moments, and test the stated scaling with a frozen fit protocol.
T007.acceptance_criteria: The runner must fail closed and enumerate every indispensable input rather than guessing the unplotted finite-lattice verification protocol.
